description: Complete Supplier (wholesaler) features in users-frontend: CSV bulk upload for stock, SKU mapping helper, incoming orders with countdown timer + photo upload + packing checklist, IMEI entry (plaintext sent, backend encrypts), payouts with commission breakdown. Supplier UI must NOT show buyer contact details (buyerId.email, buyerId.phone not rendered).
steps: Add CSV bulk upload to SupplierStock in /Users/mac/freeLancing/salebysale/salebysale-users-frontend/src/pages/Supplier.jsx: add <input type='file' accept='.csv'> below form; on file select, parse CSV with FileReader (columns: skuCode, availableQty, minimumPrice, readyInMinutes, status); call POST /supplier/inventory/bulk {items: [...]}; show success message with count; reload inventory list

Add SKU mapping helper to SupplierStock: add button 'Browse SKUs' → opens modal/expandable section → fetch GET /catalog/search?q= → display table of skus with skuCode, brand, model, variant, color → click SKU → auto-fill form's skuId dropdown

Add countdown timer to SupplierOrders in /Users/mac/freeLancing/salebysale/salebysale-users-frontend/src/pages/Supplier.jsx: for orders with status 'reserved' or 'awaiting_accept', calculate time remaining from order.acceptDeadline (5 min); use setInterval to update every second; display 'Xm Ys remaining'; when deadline passes, show 'Expired'

Add photo upload to SupplierOrders: for orders with status 'accepted' or 'paid', add <input type='file' accept='image/*'>; convert to base64 on select; show preview; pass photoUrl in POST /supplier/orders/:id/pack {imei, serial, photoUrl}

Add packing checklist to SupplierOrders: for 'accepted' or 'paid' orders, show 3 checkboxes: [ ] Sealed box verified, [ ] IMEI/serial label scanned, [ ] No tampering signs; require all checked before enabling 'Seal & pack' button

Enhance SupplierPayouts in /Users/mac/freeLancing/salebysale/salebysale-users-frontend/src/pages/Supplier.jsx: add table columns Landed Price, Platform Fee, Delivery Charge, Net Payout; fetch from GET /supplier/settlements; display inr(r.payout), inr(r.platformFee), inr(r.deliveryCharge || 0); add status filter (eligible, paid, pending)
acceptance_criteria: SupplierStock has file input; uploading CSV with 3 rows → success message '3 items uploaded'; inventory table refreshes
SupplierStock 'Browse SKUs' button → modal shows catalog; clicking SKU → form's skuId dropdown updates
SupplierOrders shows countdown timer for reserved orders (e.g., '4m 32s remaining')
SupplierOrders has photo upload field for accepted orders; preview shown; photo sent with pack request
SupplierOrders has 3-item checklist; all must be checked before 'Seal & pack' button enables
SupplierPayouts table shows 4 columns with commission breakdown; status filter works
Supplier UI never renders buyerId.email or buyerId.phone
verification: Run `npm run build` in /Users/mac/freeLancing/salebysale/salebysale-users-frontend → must exit code 0
Manual test: upload CSV with 2 SKUs → success message shows; inventory table shows new stock
Manual test: open SKU browser → click SKU → form updates
Manual test: incoming order shows countdown; accept → countdown stops; check all checklist boxes → upload photo → enter IMEI → Pack button enabled → click Pack → order status 'packing'
